description: Soft-deletes a strategy so it no longer appears in lists or can be used for backtests. Data is preserved in the database for compliance. Two-phase operation: call without confirm (or confirm=false) to preview what will be affected. Call with confirm=true to execute the deletion. Refuses if the strategy has active deployments (stop them first).

confirm.description: Set to true to actually delete. Default false returns a preview of what will be affected.

name: delete_strategy
title: Delete a strategy (soft delete)
